name: Pubic Ramus Fracture
definition: Fracture of a pubic ramus, often a fragility pelvic injury in older adults.

investigations.principle: Pelvic radiographs are initial; CT often detects associated posterior-ring injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Posterior ring injury must not be missed.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of a pubic ramus, often a fragility pelvic injury in older adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
